faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Central Bank of India Officer (Contractual) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Officer (Contractual) post is 10th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduation degree from a recognized University and have Computer Knowledge/Literacy.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Officer (Contractual) position?
faq.answer: The age limit for this post is between 60 years and 65 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Officer (Contractual) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 40,000 to Rs. 41,500 per month, plus Rs. 1,500 for conveyance and mobile recharge.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Officer (Contractual) post?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Preliminary Screening by a Committee, Evaluation/Interview by a Selection Committee, and the creation of a Merit List.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: Applications need to be submitted offline by sending the application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type is contractual, meaning the position is for a fixed term.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location?
faq.answer: The job location is Mumbai, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q10. Are retired bank officers preferred for this role?
faq.answer: Yes, retired Bank Officers will be preferred for the Officer (Contractual) position.
